dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: High degree of concavity; the trailing edge exhibits a deep inward curvature from the dorsal ridge junction to the sub-terminal point of the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded; small pixel radius at the terminal morphological point of the fin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep positive gradient; approximately 65 degrees relative to the visible horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of the visible fin base width to its maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple small, circular, light-colored epidermal spots or punctate marks on the lateral surface of the fin and the posterior dorsal region.
